exam_set.title: Practice Set 2
exam_set.description: Textbook Practice — Book 1, Chapter 16, Practice Set 2

questions.jp: ホスティングサービスの特徴はどれか。
questions.romaji: Hosutingu sābisu no tokuchō wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which statement describes a hosting service?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 運用管理面では、サーバの稼働監視、インシデント対応などを全て利用者が担う。
options.romaji: Un'yō kanri-men de wa, sāba no kadō kanshi, inshidento taiō nado o subete riyōsha ga ninau.
options.en: The user handles all server monitoring, incident response, and other operational management.

options.label: イ
options.jp: サービス事業者が用意したサーバの利用権を利用者に貸し出す。
options.romaji: Sābisu jigyōsha ga yōi shita sāba no riyōken o riyōsha ni kashidasu.
options.en: The service provider leases the right to use a server it has prepared.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: サービス事業者の高性能なサーバを利用者が専有するような使い方には対応しない。
options.romaji: Sābisu jigyōsha no kōseinō na sāba o riyōsha ga sen'yū suru yō na tsukaikata ni wa taiō shinai.
options.en: It does not support a user having exclusive use of a provider's high-performance server.

options.label: エ
options.jp: サービス事業者の施設に利用者が独自のサーバを持ち込み、サーバの選定や組合せは自由に行う。
options.romaji: Sābisu jigyōsha no shisetsu ni riyōsha ga dokuji no sāba o mochikomi, sāba no sentei ya kumiawase wa jiyū ni okonau.
options.en: The user brings its own server into the provider's facility and freely selects and combines servers.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Hosting means renting use of a server that the provider owns and prepares.

Technical breakdown:
In a hosting service, the provider supplies server resources and grants customers use of them. Service plans may include shared or dedicated servers and various management levels. Bringing customer-owned equipment into a provider facility is housing or colocation.

Japanese keywords to remember:
ホスティングサービス = hosutingu sābisu = hosting service
利用権 = riyōken = right of use
貸し出す = kashidasu = lease

Why the best solution works:
イ states the defining ownership and usage relationship: provider-prepared server, customer usage right.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Hosting management responsibility depends on the service; it is not necessarily all assigned to the user.
ウ:
Dedicated hosting can give one customer exclusive server use.
エ:
Bringing a customer-owned server to a provider facility describes housing or colocation.

Memory trick:
Hosting: provider owns server; customer rents use.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: SaaSを説明したものはどれか。
questions.romaji: SaaS o setsumei shita mono wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: インターネット経由でアプリケーションソフトウェアの機能を、利用者が必要なときだけ利用するサービスのこと
options.romaji: Intānetto keiyu de apurikēshon sofutowea no kinō o, riyōsha ga hitsuyō na toki dake riyō suru sābisu no koto
options.en: A service in which users access application software functions over the Internet when needed.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 企業の経営資源を有効に活用するために、基幹業務を統合的に管理するためのソフトウェアパッケージのこと
options.romaji: Kigyō no keiei shigen o yūkō ni katsuyō suru tame ni, kikan gyōmu o tōgōteki ni kanri suru tame no sofutowea pakkēji no koto
options.en: A software package that integrates core operations to use enterprise resources effectively.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 既存の組織やビジネスプロセスを抜本的に見直し、職務、業務フロー、管理機構、情報システムを再設計すること
options.romaji: Kizon no soshiki ya bijinesu purosesu o bapponteki ni minaoshi, shokumu, gyōmu furō, kanri kikō, jōhō shisutemu o saisekkei suru koto
options.en: Radically review existing organizations and business processes and redesign jobs, workflows, management structures, and information systems.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 発注者とサービス提供者との間で、サービスの品質の内容について合意した文書のこと
options.romaji: Hatchūsha to sābisu teikyōsha to no aida de, sābisu no hinshitsu no naiyō ni tsuite gōi shita bunsho no koto
options.en: A document in which a customer and service provider agree on service quality.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
SaaS lets you use an application through the Internet instead of installing and running the whole product yourself.

Technical breakdown:
Software as a Service provides application-level functionality over a network. The provider operates the application and underlying platform, while the user accesses functions on demand, commonly through a browser.

Japanese keywords to remember:
インターネット経由 = intānetto keiyu = over the Internet
アプリケーションソフトウェア = apurikēshon sofutowea = application software
必要なときだけ = hitsuyō na toki dake = only when needed

Why the best solution works:
ア contains both decisive features: application functions delivered over the Internet and used on demand.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
This describes ERP software.
ウ:
This describes BPR.
エ:
This describes an SLA.

Memory trick:
SaaS = software served online.

Correct answer: ア

questions.romaji: SOA no setsumei wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: 売上・利益の増加や、顧客満足度の向上のために、営業活動にITを活用して営業の効率と品質を高める概念のこと
options.romaji: Uriage rieki no zōka ya, kokyaku manzokudo no kōjō no tame ni, eigyō katsudō ni IT o katsuyō shite eigyō no kōritsu to hinshitsu o takameru gainen no koto
options.en: A concept that uses IT in sales activities to improve sales efficiency and quality, increase revenue and profit, and improve customer satisfaction.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 経営資源をコアビジネスに集中させるために、社内業務のうちコアビジネス以外の業務を外部に委託すること
options.romaji: Keiei shigen o koa bijinesu ni shūchū saseru tame ni, shanai gyōmu no uchi koa bijinesu igai no gyōmu o gaibu ni itaku suru koto
options.en: Outsource non-core internal work so management resources can focus on core business.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: コスト、品質、サービス、スピードを革新的に改善させるために、ビジネスプロセスをデザインし直す概念のこと
options.romaji: Kosuto, hinshitsu, sābisu, supīdo o kakushinteki ni kaizen saseru tame ni, bijinesu purosesu o dezain shinaosu gainen no koto
options.en: A concept of redesigning business processes to achieve innovative improvements in cost, quality, service, and speed.

options.label: エ
options.jp: ソフトウェアの機能をサービスという部品とみなし、そのサービスを組み合わせることによってシステムを構築する概念のこと
options.romaji: Sofutowea no kinō o sābisu to iu buhin to minashi, sono sābisu o kumiawaseru koto ni yotte shisutemu o kōchiku suru gainen no koto
options.en: A concept that treats software functions as service components and builds systems by combining those services.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
SOA builds a system like building blocks: each useful software function is a service, and services are combined into larger solutions.

Technical breakdown:
Service-Oriented Architecture exposes self-contained business or software capabilities through defined service interfaces. Loose coupling and composition allow services to be reused and combined without tightly binding their internal implementations.

Japanese keywords to remember:
ソフトウェアの機能 = sofutowea no kinō = software function
サービスという部品 = sābisu to iu buhin = service component
組み合わせる = kumiawaseru = combine

Why the best solution works:
エ directly states the SOA model of treating functions as services and composing systems from them.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
This describes sales-force automation.
イ:
This describes outsourcing non-core work.
ウ:
This describes BPR.

Memory trick:
SOA = services as system building blocks.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: BI（Business Intelligence）を説明したものはどれか。
questions.romaji: BI (Business Intelligence) o setsumei shita mono wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: 企業内外のデータを蓄積し、分類・加工・分析して活用することによって、企業の意思決定の迅速化を支援する手法
options.romaji: Kigyō naigai no dēta o chikuseki shi, bunrui kakō bunseki shite katsuyō suru koto ni yotte, kigyō no ishi kettei no jinsokuka o shien suru shuhō
options.en: A method that supports faster corporate decision-making by accumulating, classifying, processing, analyzing, and using internal and external data.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 企業内の慣行などにとらわれず、業務プロセスを抜本的に再構築することによって、コスト・品質・サービスなどを改善する手法
options.romaji: Kigyō-nai no kankō nado ni torawarezu, gyōmu purosesu o bapponteki ni saikōchiku suru koto ni yotte, kosuto hinshitsu sābisu nado o kaizen suru shuhō
options.en: A method that radically reconstructs business processes without being bound by company customs to improve cost, quality, and service.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 企業内の業務の流れを可視化し、業務改善サイクルを適用することによって、継続的な業務改善を図る手法
options.romaji: Kigyō-nai no gyōmu no nagare o kashika shi, gyōmu kaizen saikuru o tekiyō suru koto ni yotte, keizokuteki na gyōmu kaizen o hakaru shuhō
options.en: A method that visualizes internal workflows and applies an improvement cycle to achieve continuous business improvement.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 企業内の異なるシステムを互いに連結し、データやプロセスの統合を図ることによって、システムを全体として効率よく活用する手法
options.romaji: Kigyō-nai no kotonaru shisutemu o tagai ni renketsu shi, dēta ya purosesu no tōgō o hakaru koto ni yotte, shisutemu o zentai to shite kōritsu yoku katsuyō suru shuhō
options.en: A method that links different internal systems and integrates data and processes so the systems can be used efficiently as a whole.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
BI turns a large pile of company data into useful patterns and reports so managers can decide faster.

Technical breakdown:
Business Intelligence collects data from internal and external sources, organizes and processes it, then analyzes it using reporting, OLAP, dashboards, or related tools. Its purpose is evidence-based, timely decision support.

Japanese keywords to remember:
データを蓄積 = dēta o chikuseki = accumulate data
分類・加工・分析 = bunrui kakō bunseki = classify, process, and analyze
意思決定 = ishi kettei = decision-making

Why the best solution works:
ア describes the full BI flow from data accumulation through analysis to faster decisions.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
This describes BPR.
ウ:
This describes BPM.
エ:
This describes enterprise application integration.

Memory trick:
BI = data becomes decision intelligence.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: 企業がマーケティング活動に活用するビッグデータの特徴に沿った取扱いとして、適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Kigyō ga māketingu katsudō ni katsuyō suru biggu dēta no tokuchō ni sotta toriatsukai to shite, tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which handling method is appropriate for the characteristics of big data used in corporate marketing?

options.label: ア
options.jp: ソーシャルメディアで個人が発信する商品のクレーム情報などの、不特定多数によるデータは処理の対象にすべきではない。
options.romaji: Sōsharu media de kojin ga hasshin suru shōhin no kurēmu jōhō nado no, futokutei tasū ni yoru dēta wa shori no taishō ni subeki de wa nai.
options.en: Data from an unspecified large number of people, such as product complaints posted by individuals on social media, should not be processed.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 蓄積した静的なデータだけでなく、Webサイトのアクセス履歴などリアルタイム性の高いデータも含めて処理の対象とする。
options.romaji: Chikuseki shita seiteki na dēta dake de naku, Web saito no akusesu rireki nado riaru taimu-sei no takai dēta mo fukumete shori no taishō to suru.
options.en: Process not only stored static data but also highly real-time data such as website access histories.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: データ全体から無作為にデータをサンプリングして、それらを分析することによって全体の傾向を推し量る。
options.romaji: Dēta zentai kara musakui ni dēta o sanpuringu shite, sorera o bunseki suru koto ni yotte zentai no keikō o oshihakaru.
options.en: Randomly sample data from the whole and analyze the sample to estimate the overall trend.

options.label: エ
options.jp: データの正規化が難しい非構造化データである音声データや画像データは、処理の対象にすべきではない。
options.romaji: Dēta no seikika ga muzukashii hikōzōka dēta de aru onsei dēta ya gazō dēta wa, shori no taishō ni subeki de wa nai.
options.en: Audio and image data, which are unstructured and difficult to normalize, should not be processed.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Big data includes data arriving quickly right now, not only old records stored in a database. Website clicks can reveal current customer behavior.

Technical breakdown:
Big data is commonly characterized by volume, velocity, and variety. Real-time web access logs demonstrate velocity and should be included when useful. Social posts, audio, and images demonstrate variety rather than data that must be excluded. Large-scale processing can also analyze more than a small sample.

Japanese keywords to remember:
ビッグデータ = biggu dēta = big data
リアルタイム性 = riaru taimu-sei = real-time nature
アクセス履歴 = akusesu rireki = access history
非構造化データ = hikōzōka dēta = unstructured data

Why the best solution works:
イ accepts both stored data and fast-arriving behavioral data, matching big data's velocity characteristic.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Social-media data is a valuable big-data source despite coming from many unspecified people.
ウ:
Sampling may be useful in some analyses, but big-data technology is designed to exploit very large datasets rather than defining them by mandatory sampling.
エ:
Audio and images are important examples of big data's variety and can be processed with suitable methods.

Memory trick:
Big data 3V: volume, velocity, variety.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: 企業が保有する顧客や市場などの膨大なデータから、有用な情報や関係を見つけ出す手法はどれか。
questions.romaji: Kigyō ga hoyū suru kokyaku ya shijō nado no bōdai na dēta kara, yūyō na jōhō ya kankei o mitsukedasu shuhō wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which technique discovers useful information and relationships in massive customer and market data held by a company?

options.label: ア
options.jp: データウェアハウス
options.romaji: Dēta uea hausu
options.en: Data warehouse

options.label: イ
options.jp: データディクショナリ
options.romaji: Dēta dikushonari
options.en: Data dictionary

options.label: ウ
options.jp: データフローダイアグラム
options.romaji: Dēta furō daiyaguramu
options.en: Data flow diagram

options.label: エ
options.jp: データマイニング
options.romaji: Dēta mainingu
options.en: Data mining

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Data mining digs through huge datasets to find hidden patterns, such as which products customers often buy together.

Technical breakdown:
Data mining applies statistical, machine-learning, and pattern-discovery techniques to large datasets. It extracts correlations, classifications, clusters, sequences, or predictive rules that were not obvious beforehand.

Japanese keywords to remember:
膨大なデータ = bōdai na dēta = massive data
有用な情報 = yūyō na jōhō = useful information
関係を見つけ出す = kankei o mitsukedasu = discover relationships
データマイニング = dēta mainingu = data mining

Why the best solution works:
エ is the analysis method specifically used to discover useful patterns and relationships in large data collections.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
A data warehouse stores and integrates analysis-ready data; it does not itself denote pattern discovery.
イ:
A data dictionary defines metadata such as field names, types, and meanings.
ウ:
A data flow diagram models how data moves through processes and stores.

Memory trick:
Mine data to uncover hidden value.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: デジタルディバイドを説明したものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Dejitaru dibaido o setsumei shita mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which statement describes the digital divide?

options.label: ア
options.jp: PCなどの情報通信機器の利用方法が分からなかったり、情報通信機器を所有していなかったりして、情報の入手が困難な人々のことである。
options.romaji: PC nado no jōhō tsūshin kiki no riyō hōhō ga wakaranakattari, jōhō tsūshin kiki o shoyū shite inakattari shite, jōhō no nyūshu ga konnan na hitobito no koto de aru.
options.en: People who have difficulty obtaining information because they do not know how to use ICT equipment such as PCs or do not own it.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 高齢者や障害者の情報通信の利用面での困難が、社会的又は経済的な格差につながらないように、誰もが情報通信を利活用できるように整備された環境のことである。
options.romaji: Kōreisha ya shōgaisha no jōhō tsūshin no riyō-men de no konnan ga, shakaiteki mata wa keizaiteki na kakusa ni tsunagaranai yō ni, daremo ga jōhō tsūshin o rikatsuyō dekiru yō ni seibi sareta kankyō no koto de aru.
options.en: An environment arranged so everyone can use ICT and difficulties faced by older people or people with disabilities do not create social or economic disparities.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 情報通信機器やソフトウェア、情報サービスなどを、高齢者・障害者を含む全ての人が利用可能であるか、利用しやすくなっているかの度合いのことである。
options.romaji: Jōhō tsūshin kiki ya sofutowea, jōhō sābisu nado o, kōreisha shōgaisha o fukumu subete no hito ga riyō kanō de aru ka, riyō shiyasuku natte iru ka no doai no koto de aru.
options.en: The degree to which ICT equipment, software, and information services are available and easy to use for everyone, including older people and people with disabilities.

options.label: エ
options.jp: デジタルリテラシーの有無やITの利用環境の相違などによって生じる、社会的又は経済的な格差のことである。
options.romaji: Dejitaru riterashī no umu ya IT no riyō kankyō no sōi nado ni yotte shōjiru, shakaiteki mata wa keizaiteki na kakusa no koto de aru.
options.en: A social or economic disparity caused by differences in digital literacy or IT access environments.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
When some people can use digital tools and networks while others cannot, the difference can create unequal chances in work, education, and daily life. That gap is the digital divide.

Technical breakdown:
The digital divide is the resulting social or economic disparity between people or groups with different access to ICT, usage environments, or digital skills. The decisive word is 格差, disparity, not merely an individual difficulty or a measure designed to improve access.

Japanese keywords to remember:
デジタルリテラシー = dejitaru riterashī = digital literacy
利用環境 = riyō kankyō = usage environment
社会的又は経済的な格差 = shakaiteki mata wa keizaiteki na kakusa = social or economic disparity

Why the best solution works:
エ defines both the causes, differences in literacy or environment, and the result, social or economic disparity.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
This describes digitally disadvantaged people, not the disparity itself.
イ:
This describes an inclusive environment intended to prevent the divide.
ウ:
This describes accessibility, the degree to which products and services are usable by everyone.

Memory trick:
Digital divide = digital difference creates life gap.

Correct answer: エ
